div.head: II Cn 75.1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe þæt wæpn áge, hine geladige, gif he durre, þæt hit næfre næs naðer ne his gewill ne his geweald ne his ræd ne his gewitnes: þonne is þæt Godes riht, þæt he beo clæne.
And se ðe þæt wæpen age, hine geladige, gif he durre, þæt hit næffre næs naðer ne his gewyll ne his geweald ne his ræd ne his gewitnes: þonne his þæt Godes riht, þæt he beo clæne.
Et si ille, cuius armis malefactum est, se adlegiare audeat, quod nec uelle nec (uel) posse suum fuerit nec (uel) testimonium, Dei rectum est, ut inde quietus sit.
And se ðe þæt wepn age, hine geladige, gyf he durre, ðæt hit næfre næs naðer ne his gewill ne his geweald ne his ræd ne his gewitnes; ðonne is þæt Godes riht, þæt he beo clæne.
And se ðe þæt wæpn age, hine geladige, gif he durre, þæt hit næfre næs naðer ne his gewill ne his geweald ne his ræd ne his gewitnes; þonne is þæt Godes riht þæt he beo clæne.

Und wer die Waffe zu eigen hat, reinige sich, wenn er es wagt [durch dén Eid], dass es [das Verbrechen] nimmer weder sein Wille, noch seine Absicht, noch sein Rath, noch sein Mitwissen war: dann ist es Gottes [d. h. vollkommenes] Recht, dass er rein dastehe.

And whoever owns the weapon, let him clear himself, if he dares, [by the oath] that it [the crime] was never either his will, nor his intention, nor his counsel, nor his knowledge: then it is God's [that is, perfect] right that he stand clean.

And he who owns the weapon shall clear himself, if he dare, asserting that the mischief was done without his desire or authority or advice or cognisance; then according to the law of God he shall be clear [of any charge of complicity].
And he who owns the weapon is to clear himself, if he dare, that it was never either his wish or his intention or his advice or his cognisance; then it is the law of God that he should be clear.

And the weapon’s owner shall, if he dares, swear an oath of exculpation that he had neither intention nor authority nor complicity nor awareness concerning the crime; then by God’s law he shall be considered innocent.
